title: 6DQ reconciliation input v1
description: Two keyword arguments to aggregate_6dq. All references are local; no fetching. Closed structural schema, not eligibility/trust proof. Runtime adds exact-native types, UTF-8 byte limits (4096/string, 8388608 aggregate), 100000 occurrence/32 depth limits, ordering/identity uniqueness, calendar, policy-v1 validation and cross-record semantic checks. Reject duplicate JSON keys/nonstandard constants before calling. JSON Schema integers alone cannot reject Python bool/float/subclasses. Unsupported version integers have a distinct runtime fallback.

Text.description: Nonblank by Python whitespace semantics, strict UTF-8, no C0/C1. Runtime bounds UTF-8 bytes (not code points) at 4096.

Path.description: Literal Git-relative UTF-8 path, no normalization; runtime also bounds UTF-8 byte length.
